senses: a river in the infernal regions
la:noun:Styx.html:
Styx, ўgis and ўgos, f., = Στύξ.
A fountain in Arcadia, the icy-cold water of which caused death, ; ; ; ; .—
In mythology, a river in the infernal regions, by which the gods swore, ; ; ; ; ; ; — Hence, poet., the infernal regions, the lower world, ; ; ; ; ; and for poison: miscuit undis Styga Sidoniis,.—Hence,
Stўgĭus, a, um, adj., of or belonging to the Styx, Stygian; and poet., of or belonging to the lower world, infernal: palus,: aquae,: torrens,: cymba,i. e. of Charon,; so, carina,: Juppiter,i. e. Pluto,; cf. : frater,: Juno,i.e. Proserpine,: canes,: manes,: umbrae,.—Hence, poet., deadly, fatal, pernicious, awful, etc.: vis,; cf. nox,i. e. death,: bubo, et saep.—*
Stўgĭālis, e, adj., Stygian: sacra,.
